steps.content: The backlash of the shackles is incessant, and you are drenched in cold sweat. Releasing the shackles, your right arm is covered in bulging veins, trembling uncontrollably.
On the other end of the shackles, the red glow of contamination on Yanyan's body finally starts to flicker unsteadily.
The monster possessing Yanyan is declaring its ownership, but you refuse to let go.
Your vision starts to blur, possibly due to the heat of the steam or your fading consciousness. You can only force yourself to stay awake with the pain in your palm.
But you cannot last long. Eventually, you black out...
We've found Chief and that girl!
In your coma, you hear the sound of armor approaching. Apparently, the Hypercube shields are right beside you, protecting you.
As you ask, you see Yanyan lying in the arms of another person in white armor, smacking her lips.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: The envoy is fine. Thankfully, you intervened in time. But you're not in the best shape. Please take care of yourself first, Chief.
Right. You just used the shackles, and they caught fire again after touching the Wraith Spirit possessing Yanyan, just like when you first drove away the Sun Crow.
So that thing really was the Sun Crow Apostle. Did it invade Yanyan's mind by taking advantage of her psychical nature?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm fine. I feel much better now. Take Yanyan back first, she...
Look at the state you're in before you worry about Yanyan.
A cold hand presses against your forehead, and everything calms down again. It's that familiar scent of incense. As you tilt your head up, you finally see who is holding you.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Yes, it's me again.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Stop being so harsh toward yourself. It makes my heart ache to see a saint like you suffer.
Her composed smile somehow calms you down a lot, and you're surprised that Du Ruo, who's usually reluctant to go out, came promptly.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The materials for the Almighty Bow are all safe. Relax and just rest. You both have worked hard.
Du Ruo waves the incense burner in her hand, covering the small camp with green smoke, healing the injuries of you, the soldiers, and Yanyan.
